bioconda.name: gcen2
bioconda.summary: Gene co-expression network analysis from bulk to single-cell and spatial transcriptomes
bioconda.description:
GCEN2 is a command-line tool and Python package (with C++ kernels) for gene
co-expression network analysis, the successor of GCEN. It does everything GCEN
does, with the same commands, files and results, and adds differential
co-expression, WGCNA module analysis, the hdWGCNA single-cell and spatial
workflows, networks along trajectories, multi-omics networks, publication
figures and reports.
